verdict.rationale: Glama's core product is a searchable registry/catalog of MCP servers with capability inspection (glama-docs-6, glama-docs-11, glama-probe-1 confirming ~90k servers and 23k connectors), plus tooling to inspect capabilities before wiring in (inspector, pre-filled client configs in glama-docs-13/14). Community evidence corroborates real usage of the catalog and quality scoring, though notes it's easy to get lost among many listings. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of search/filter quality by capability, and confirmation of robust capability-based filtering UI beyond text search.
